# grow.contact

> grow.contact is an agent-native website agency that builds marketing sites for AI startups, agent platforms, and developer tools — engineered to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews from day one. Fixed price. 48-hour delivery. Score-first proof.

grow.contact is not affiliated with grow.com (a B2B sales platform). This is grow.contact — the GEO and agent-native web agency operated by Gudmundur Eyberg Kristjansson.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://grow.contact/): Agency overview, live agent-readability dashboard, free instant scan tool.
- [Services](https://grow.contact/services): Three services — Agent-Native Website Build, Agent Readability Audit, Schema Optimization.
- [Process](https://grow.contact/process): Five-step workflow from brief to live agent-readable site in 48 hours.
- [Work](https://grow.contact/work): Client case studies with before/after agent-readability scores.
- [Pricing](https://grow.contact/pricing): Fixed pricing — Starter $2,400 (1 page, 48 hours), Growth $4,800 (up to 5 pages).
- [Leaderboard](https://grow.contact/leaderboard): Open dataset — agent-readability scores for 390+ AI companies across infra, models, agents, and dev tools. Filterable by category and failing signal.
- [Leaderboard methodology](https://grow.contact/leaderboard/methodology): Scoring weights, pass thresholds, refresh cadence, dataset license (CC BY 4.0), and citable headline statistics.
- [Leaderboard JSON API](https://grow.contact/api/public/leaderboard.json): Full dataset as JSON. CORS-open, CC BY 4.0. Includes headline_stats with quotable percentages for journalists and analysts.
- [Journal](https://grow.contact/blog): GEO guides, agent-native web patterns, and AI citation research.
- [GEO Glossary](https://grow.contact/glossary): Canonical definitions for the terms shaping agent-native web — llms.txt, MCP, JSON-LD, OAI-SearchBot, Information Gain, Citability, and more. DefinedTerm JSON-LD on every entry.
- [AI Crawler Reference](https://grow.contact/crawlers): Per-bot reference for every major AI crawler (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, bingbot, FacebookBot). User-agents, IP ranges, robots.txt recommendations, and citation impact.
- [State of the Agent-Readable Web](https://grow.contact/stats): Permanent citable-stats page over the leaderboard dataset. Every figure has a stable anchor and a copy-ready citation snippet. CC BY 4.0.
- [Trust & Guarantees](https://grow.contact/trust): Founder bio, 100/100 delivery guarantee, public scoring methodology, refund policy, and independent receipts (Lighthouse, /check on grow.contact itself, open dataset).
- [GEO Playbooks](https://grow.contact/playbooks): Step-by-step HowTo playbooks for earning AI citations — robots.txt for ChatGPT, llms.txt in 10 minutes, Cloudflare WAF fixes, Perplexity listicle format, Google AI Overviews answer-first content, and more. Each ships HowTo JSON-LD.
- [Compare AI Companies](https://grow.contact/compare): Head-to-head agent-readability comparisons of the AI companies buyers actually compare — Anthropic vs OpenAI, Perplexity vs ChatGPT, Vercel vs Modal, Pinecone vs Weaviate, and 20+ more.
- [Q2 2026 Report — State of the Agent-Readable Web](https://grow.contact/report/q2-2026): Quarterly flagship research. Six headline findings on AI-citation readiness across 390+ AI companies, category breakdown, top/bottom rankings, copy-paste citation block (APA, BibTeX, pull quote). CC BY 4.0.
- [Report Methodology](https://grow.contact/report/methodology): How the agent-readability score is computed — five signals, weights, pass thresholds, scan cadence, limitations, changelog.
- [Press Kit](https://grow.contact/report/press): Pull quotes, downloadable headline stats, author bio (short + long), media contact, suggested interview topics. CC BY 4.0.
- [Data Drops](https://grow.contact/data-drops): Monthly single-stat findings on agent-readability between quarterly reports. Each drop ships NewsArticle JSON-LD, copy-paste citations, and a computed-from-dataset basis line.



## Tools

- [Agent Readability Check](https://grow.contact/check): Free URL scanner. Scores any site across Semantic HTML, JSON-LD, llms.txt, Citability, Page Speed, and Protocol Discovery. No signup required.
- [robots.txt Checker for AI Crawlers](https://grow.contact/tools/robots-checker): Free in-browser tool. Paste a robots.txt, get back which AI engines can cite the site and which are blocked. Surfaces the common GPTBot vs OAI-SearchBot confusion that silently kills ChatGPT citations.
- [grow CLI](https://grow.contact/cli): Zero-dep Node CLI (`npx @grow-contact/cli check <url>`). Same six-signal score as the web scanner, CI-friendly `--fail-under` flag. MIT licensed.
